Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join assays to activities on assay_id. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id equals CHEMBL1217643. Filter activities.standard_relation equals '='. Filter activities.standard_value is not null. Filter activities.standard_relation is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles ascending, molecule_chembl_id ascending, standard_type ascending, standard_relation ascending, standard_value ascending, standard_units ascending. Limit None.
